tracking: ADR-0313 (lane E2, G9): API-only paid-call price and hold routes; the screens are posted on #453

gaps.GET /v1/paid-call-prices: lists paid-call prices (MCP tool, MCP server or connector): price, reserved maximum and hold TTL
gaps.POST /v1/paid-call-prices: makes a tool, server or connector a paid call that must reserve against a budget (audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/paid-call-prices/:priceId: removes a paid-call price, a relaxation (settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.GET /v1/paid-call-holds: pages paid-call holds: held, settled (with the usage row) or released, and why
